ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity black/dark-grey to high-intensity white/light-grey pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jaggedness and small missing tissue segments at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
